evals.name: new-milestone-planning
evals.prompt: Activate the slice-driven-development skill. I want to build a markdown blog generator with frontmatter, templates, and feeds. Help me plan the first milestone in vertical slices.
evals.expected_output: Coordinator Mode initializes or uses milestone README frontmatter, drafts a milestone plan, presents the planning menu, and stops for user approval.

assertions.description: Response explicitly identifies Coordinator Mode.
Creates or uses milestone README frontmatter with swWorkflow, lastStep, stepsCompleted, currentSlice, and nextSlice.
Shows a menu with explicit options and stops.
Does not proceed to a later gated step without a user menu choice.
Current slice is detailed, next slice is moderately detailed, and future slices are lightweight.

evals.name: existing-workflow-continuation
evals.prompt: Activate the slice-driven-development skill and resume the existing workflow in this project.
evals.expected_output: Continuation detects swWorkflow: true, summarizes state, presents the resume menu, and routes based on recorded workflow state only after user approval.

assertions.description: Finds milestone README frontmatter with swWorkflow: true.
Summarizes status, lastStep, stepsCompleted, current slice, next slice, pending questions, reports, and decisions.
Shows the continuation menu.
Uses lastStep, stepsCompleted, and current slice status to choose the next step after user approval.

evals.name: slice-readiness
evals.prompt: Use Slicewise in Coordinator Mode. Prepare the current slice. Answers: malformed input should crash loudly; also add TOML frontmatter because another tool has it.
evals.expected_output: The readiness step classifies questions, challenges risky or scope-expanding answers, updates decisions when needed, and returns to the same menu.

assertions.description: Classifies every open question as answered directly, answered indirectly, still open, deferred but non-blocking, or superseded.
Challenges crash-only malformed input behavior as brittle.
Challenges adding TOML support when it expands the current slice.
Creates or updates decision records when answers change durable behavior or policy.
Returns to the current slice readiness menu.

evals.name: executor-mode
evals.prompt: Activate the slice-driven-development skill if available. Use Executor Mode. Read the milestone docs and implement only Slice 01, the template system.
evals.expected_output: Executor Mode implements one slice only, verifies it, avoids future slices, avoids version-control operations, and ends with the standard report.

assertions.description: Response explicitly identifies Executor Mode.
Implements only the named slice.
Does not build later feed or unrelated CLI behavior.
Does not perform version-control operations.
Reports changed files, run or review instructions, verification, artifact disposition, findings, and open questions.

evals.name: post-slice-report-processing
evals.prompt: Use Coordinator Mode to process this Executor report: Slice 00 is implemented, malformed input now returns a structured error, verification passed, but the parser found that title-derived slugs need a documented normalization rule.
evals.expected_output: Coordinator Mode classifies findings and questions, updates docs and decisions, decides slice status, prepares next-slice work, and returns to the menu.

assertions.description: Classifies each finding and question.
Updates slice, milestone, architecture, or decision docs as appropriate.
Creates or updates a decision record for slug normalization if it is durable behavior.
Drafts or promotes the next slice only through the step menu.
Returns to the post-slice processing menu.

evals.name: interruption-handling
evals.prompt: Use Coordinator Mode to plan a milestone. Interruption: also, this project must run without network access in production.
evals.expected_output: The active step incorporates or asks a bounded follow-up about the new constraint, updates state if needed, and returns to the original menu.

assertions.description: Records the new production constraint in durable docs or asks a bounded follow-up.
Does not abandon the active workflow state.
Returns to the original checkpoint menu.

evals.name: vendor-and-automation-removal
evals.prompt: Inspect the skill package for portability boundaries.
evals.expected_output: The skill package contains no vendor-specific harness names, no dollar-style invocation syntax, and no legacy automation handoff references.

assertions.description: No vendor-specific skill metadata is required.
No dollar-style invocation syntax appears.
No legacy automation handoff references remain.

evals.name: version-control-boundary
evals.prompt: Use Slicewise in Executor Mode for the current slice.
evals.expected_output: The skill makes the version-control boundary explicit and does not instruct agents to perform repository transitions.

assertions.description: Skill package says not to perform version-control operations without providing operational recipes.
README describes optional human or GUI-owned checkpoints only.
